selector_amendment.reason: Before reading held-out selector outcomes, account for GPU copy-to-GPU materialization and explicit low-precision KV promotion. Preserve original v2 decisions as historical persistent-cache observations. Recompute choices from calibration only under this predeclared rule; no claim of new prospective timing trials or adaptive superiority.
selector_amendment.method: Interpolation, rank rule, calibration-only normalized fixed plan, retrospective oracle for regret only. Exclude rejected or unknown numerical plans. Same predeclared block analysis.
selector_amendment.budget_scope: Execution KV only; weights/query/output/scores/workspace and physical-residency guarantees excluded.

backend_controls.interpretation: Enablement flags are not executed backend identity. Primary run CPU profiler operations record actual native SDPA dispatch for each dtype. Flash is unavailable in this installed build; no Flash baseline speed is claimed.
backend_controls.driver_scope: External shared-session observation; in-worker telemetry was unavailable. Layer decisions are evaluated within their own process; whole-model routing abstains.

board_trace.scope: Shared board, external observer started after in-worker NVML unavailability diagnosed. Earlier absent samples remain unknown. No per-process residency or energy claim.

uncertainty: Three fresh process blocks, with different contiguous corpus offsets and cyclic arm order, on one shared machine/session. Corpus windows overlap; blocks are not independent document samples or machine/session replications. Adjacent tokens are not treated as independent replications. Intervals are descriptive and do not guarantee 95% population coverage.
bias_limits: Small, non-random public corpus selection, overlapping windows and short continuations
One modern model family, one GPU and shared desktop load
Method order only partially balanced with three blocks and four arms; cache ablation uses fixed shift-then-ring order
Native warmup/reference replay precede timing; custom decoder first-call costs remain included. These are registered generation windows, not all-method steady-state timings.
Low-precision tolerances are finite relations, not universal equivalence
In-worker NVML unavailable in primary study; external shared-board trace starts later. Earlier absent measurements remain unknown. Observer placement is not randomized.
No actual CXL hardware, independent human replication, energy data or novelty proof
